bool ascs_get_ase_data(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t ase_id, T_ASE_CHAR_DATA *p_ase_data)

Get ASCS ASE data.

ascs_mgr.h

Parameters:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle.

  • ase_id -- [in] ASE id.

  • p_ase_data -- [inout] Pointer to ASE data: T_ASE_CHAR_DATA.

Return values:

  • true -- Getting ASE data is successful.

  • false -- Getting ASE data failed.

Returns:

The result of getting ASE data.

bool ascs_cfg_ase_prefer_qos(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t ase_id, T_ASCS_PREFER_QOS_DATA *p_qos)

Set ASE preferred QoS data.

ascs_mgr.h

This api shall be called when handle LE_AUDIO_MSG_ASCS_GET_PREFER_QOS.

Note

The APP must use this API for configuration when the codec is not LC3_CODEC_ID.

Parameters:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle.

  • ase_id -- [in] ASE ID.

  • p_qos -- [in] Pointer to ASE preferred QoS data: T_ASCS_PREFER_QOS_DATA.

Return values:

  • true -- Set ASE preferred QoS data is successful.

  • false -- Set ASE preferred QoS data failed.

Returns:

The result of set ASE preferred QoS data.

bool ascs_app_ctl_handshake(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t ase_id, bool app_handshake)

ASCS configures Application control start/stop ready operation.

ascs_mgr.h

This API is only used when the unicast server is in the audio sink role. This API is used to control whether the LE Audio library sends the receiver stop ready operation or receiver start ready operation automatically.

Parameters:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle.

  • ase_id -- [in] ASE ID.

  • app_handshake -- [in] Application controls the handshake. The default value is false.

    • true Application controls the start/stop ready operation.

    • false Application does not control the start/stop ready operation.

Return values:

  • true -- ASCS configuring Application control handshake is successful.

  • false -- ASCS configuring Application control handshake failed.

Returns:

The result of ASCS configuring Application control handshake.

bool ascs_action_rec_start_ready(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t ase_id)

ASCS performs receiver start ready operation.

ascs_mgr.h

This API is only used when the parameter app_handshake of ascs_app_ctl_handshake is true and the application has received ASE_CP_OP_ENABLE.

Parameters:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle.

  • ase_id -- [in] ASE ID.

Return values:

  • true -- Performing receiver start ready operation is successful.

  • false -- Performing receiver start ready operation failed.

Returns:

The result of ASCS performing receiver start ready operation.

bool ascs_action_rec_stop_ready(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t ase_id)

ASCS performs receiver stop ready operation.

ascs_mgr.h

This API is only used when the parameter app_handshake of ascs_app_ctl_handshake is true and the application has received ASE_CP_OP_DISABLE.

Parameters:

  • ase_id -- [in] ASE ID.

Return values:

Returns:

The result of ASCS performing receiver stop ready operation.
